scenes.narration: Why are gamers worth just 7 cents of every Nvidia dollar?
Gaming made 16 billion dollars. Sounds huge, right?
Then look at data centers. 193.7 billion.
But one quarter of data centers? 62.3 billion.
That's almost four years of gaming. In three months.

sources.title: NVIDIA Q4 and fiscal 2026 results (press release)

loop: So next time you game on a new graphics card, ask yourself:
cta: Gamers or data centers? Comment who Nvidia should pick.
